desc: Must: C4 - delete ops.InitProject with its tests and A7 ratchet entry, and run the four init branch Git subprocesses through gitenv timed runners in the project root
done_when: internal/ops/init_project.go and init_project_test.go are gone, no InitProject or InitProjectParams reference remains in cmd or internal except the never-edited s1_snapshot_test.go, area_a7_test.go holds no InitProject key and its closure assertion requires an empty A7 Ratchet; setupIsolatedAwaitProject initializes through InitCommandWithConfig and TestAwaitResubmission_TerminalFlow passes unchanged; the four helper subprocesses run through gitenv Output/CombinedOutput in the project root with timeouts reported as errors wrapping *gitenv.TimeoutError, never as negative answers (PD-1 to PD-4); the P1 and P3 tests and the root subtests of P2 fail on pre-C4 production code (recorded) and pass, the P2 precedence test passes; A7 install and present goldens unchanged; C0-C7 pass; the manifest maps every allocated obligation.
scope: Delete internal/ops/init_project.go and its test; area_a7_test.go InitProject key and closure assertion; the internal/commands MAS init entry, discovery ordering and the four branch helpers wherever Scope 17 placed them; new internal/commands/init_git_root_test.go and call-site-only helper edits in existing init tests; setupIsolatedAwaitProject in internal/integration/await_verdict_test.go; the acceptance manifest. Out: other init behaviour and Git sites, cmd/liza launch --cwd, gitenv/paths/internal/git code, s1_snapshot_test.go, windows-weights.json, oracle files and goldens, ADRs, architectural-issues.md, chain documents.
